title: pvWritePNGWriter
body:
## pvWritePNGWriter

Explicit-export writer that stores image data (vtkImageData) as PNG, a lossless raster format holding 1 to 4 components of unsigned char (8-bit) or unsigned short (16-bit) values. It suits masks, label images and already-quantized images, not floating-point simulation fields; this writes data values, unlike a rendered scene image. Publication uses the pixels contract: the PNG is read back and its dimensions, components and values are compared with the input scalars. Use pvWriteTIFFWriter for 32-bit float data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Float or double arrays are not supported; rescale and convert them to 8- or 16-bit integers upstream, because Schemaxis performs no implicit conversion.
- Natively a 3-D image can be written as a numbered slice stack through a file pattern, but Schemaxis manages the file name, so export 2-D images.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with default options; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `PNGWriter`. Identity: `writers/PNGWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "pixels",
  "extensions": [
    "png"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWritePNGWriter",
  "acceptLosses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ]
}
```
